label: FINDING
title: No view-only permission for profiles; the page shows a raw permission error
env: staging-crm.taviportal.com (owner, test user 1) vs Zoho CRM org943261092 (read-only captures)

panels.caption: TAVI — test user 1 (no iam.profile.manage) opens Settings › Permissions by URL: the page opens and its profile list shows "Missing required permission 'iam.profile.manage'."; GET /iam/profiles answers 403.

rows: A user who may only look at profiles sees a read-only page
Not possible: the permission catalog has only iam.profile.manage, no view-only permission
A user without access gets a clear "no access" page
The page opens by URL and shows the raw permission key in red
